title: Telnet BBS Guide
summary: A curated directory listing Telnet-based Bulletin Board Systems (BBS) that remain active online, serving as a comprehensive guide for retro computing enthusiasts to connect with vintage dial-up era communities.
problem_solved: Helps users discover and access surviving Telnet BBS systems from the pre-internet era, preserving retro computing culture and communities.
why_valuable: Provides a valuable resource for retro computing enthusiasts and those interested in exploring the nostalgic roots of online communities, while preserving digital heritage.
